'''Ikon''' was a [[Red dwarf/Legends|red dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="ROC" /> in the [[Ikon system/Legends|Ikon system]] of the [[Majoor sector/Legends|Majoor sector]],<ref name="Online Companion" /> located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> of the [[Expansion Region]].<ref name="Online Companion" /> It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by an [[Ikon asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], where [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizers<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|81|Ikon}}</ref> had gained a foothold under the nose of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ROC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ikon appeared in the [[River of Chaos 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: River of Chaos]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series, which was written by [[Louise Simonson]] and illustrated by [[June Brigman]].<ref name="ROC" /> Issue 1 was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[June 6]], [[1995]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54538/star_wars_river_of_chaos_1995_1|text=Star Wars: River of Chaos (1995) #1}}</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Ikon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the star Ikon, in grid square N-15.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
